description: Piles of colorful plastic beads are spread across the green tablecloth, with a gray cup in the middle and a small cluster of red beads near the hands. The left hand and right hand work together on a red beaded strand, pinching and feeding the string through so a bead is unthreaded and then rethreaded, with the left hand lifting the strand up briefly before bringing it back down while the right hand steadies and nudges the bead cluster into place.
